item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】FLAC - Black Sabbath - Past Lives [Vinyl, 2xLP] (2002) Hi-Res
item.description:
Black Sabbath - Past Lives [Vinyl, 2xLP] (2002) Hi-Res



Long Out-of-Print Live Collection Documents Peak-Era Black Sabbath: Pressed at QRP for True Audiophile Quality, Past Lives Features 18 Tracks Recorded Onstage Between 1970 and 1975.
Black Sabbath's dazzling live collection Past Lives, originally released in 2002 but long out-of-print, is finally again available in its original double vinyl configuration and for the first time available in true audiophile quality courtesy of this QRP pressing. The explosive 18-track offering features performances recorded between 1970 and 1975, when the band was at the height of its dark powers. A can't-miss snapshot of Ozzy Osbourne and Co. in their prime, it includes phenomenal live versions of essential Sabbath cuts like "Sweet Leaf," "Snowblind," "War Pigs," "Paranoid," "Iron Man," "N.I.B.." and "Fairies Wear Boots."
